data.title: Unified Workspace for Programme Operations
data.short_description: A central operations platform that brings a development programme's tasks, finances, hiring and documents into one secure workspace.
data.heading: Unified Workspace for Programme Operations
data.description:
A central operations platform that brings a development programme's tasks, finances, hiring and documents into one secure workspace.

Our Solution & Results

We built a modular platform on PHP (CodeIgniter) and MySQL with role-based access control. Modules cover task management, financial dashboards, recruitment and procurement workflows, calendar scheduling and secure file sharing.

The team now coordinates projects from a single system. Clearer reporting has improved accountability and strengthened internal governance.
data.challenge_description: The programme team ran its work across scattered tools and manual processes. Tracking tasks, budgets and approvals was slow, and accountability was hard to maintain.

data.title: Website for an Education Reform Network
data.short_description: The official website for a non-profit working to improve public education across Pakistan.
data.card_image_alt: Website for an Education Reform Network
data.heading: Website for an Education Reform Network
data.description:
The official website for a non-profit working to improve public education across Pakistan.

Our Solution & Results

We built the website with PHP (CodeIgniter) and JavaScript, using ApexCharts for data visualisation. Responsive design keeps it easy to use on any device.

The site gives the organisation a central online presence, strengthening stakeholder communication and donor engagement across the country.
data.hero_image_alt: Website for an Education Reform Network
data.challenge_description: The organisation runs school adoption, digital learning and intervention programmes. It needed one clear place to explain them to donors, partners and the public.

data.title: One Dashboard for Every Customer Channel
data.short_description: A CRM that unifies a diagnostic lab's customer service channels into one real-time dashboard.
data.card_image_alt: One Dashboard for Every Customer Channel
data.heading: One Dashboard for Every Customer Channel
data.description:
A CRM that unifies a diagnostic lab's customer service channels into one real-time dashboard.

Our Solution & Results

We integrated NEXUS, Home Sampling, WhatsApp Business and Aheeva CCS into a single dashboard. Automated reporting, live data sync and performance monitoring tools keep the team and its managers aligned.

The department now responds faster, with clearer oversight and better insight from unified reports, which has improved the customer experience.
data.hero_image_alt: One Dashboard for Every Customer Channel
data.challenge_description: The customer relations team worked across several disconnected systems. That slowed responses and gave managers no single view of performance.

data.title: Freight Dispatch & Logistics Platform
data.short_description: A dispatch management system that helps a logistics company plan loads, optimise routes and track shipments in real time.
data.heading: Freight Dispatch & Logistics Platform
data.description:
A dispatch management system that helps a logistics company plan loads, optimise routes and track shipments in real time.

Our Solution & Results

We built the platform on PHP (CodeIgniter) with a dynamic JavaScript front end and ApexCharts visualisations. It supports load management, route optimisation and live tracking on any device.

Coordination has improved, and real-time data gives the team full visibility, making dispatch operations easier to scale.
data.challenge_description: Dispatch work relied on manual coordination, so the team struggled to keep loads, routes and drivers in sync around the clock.

data.title: Cloud Order Management for Multi-Region Sales
data.short_description: A cloud-native SaaS platform that digitises order intake, tracking and fulfilment for businesses selling across several regions.
data.card_image_alt: Cloud Order Management for Multi-Region Sales
data.heading: Cloud Order Management for Multi-Region Sales
data.description:
A cloud-native SaaS platform that digitises order intake, tracking and fulfilment for businesses selling across several regions.

We engineered a modular, multi-tenant platform with secure RESTful APIs and an event-driven architecture. It includes role-based access, dynamic dashboards and ready-made integrations for POS, CRM, WhatsApp and logistics systems.

Clients gain real-time performance monitoring and location-based analytics, improving transparency and sales across their markets.
data.hero_image_alt: Cloud Order Management for Multi-Region Sales

data.heading: Shopify Storefront for a Gifting & Floral Brand
data.description:

data.title: B2B Wholesale Ordering App
data.short_description: A mobile marketplace that connects retailers with suppliers across Pakistan for simple, fast wholesale buying.
data.heading: B2B Wholesale Ordering App
data.description:
A mobile marketplace that connects retailers with suppliers across Pakistan for simple, fast wholesale buying.

Our Solution & Results

We built the app in Flutter (Dart), with a Node.js and Express.js back end and a MongoDB database. It includes live order tracking, secure payments, wholesale pricing management and a streamlined ordering flow.

Retailers can now browse large catalogues, order at competitive prices and get next-day delivery, which simplifies procurement and strengthens the supply chain.
data.challenge_description: Retailers needed an easier way to compare wholesale prices, place orders and track deliveries without long phone calls and paperwork.

data.title: Digital Health Camp & Dispensary System
data.short_description: A mobile and web system that helps an NGO deliver and record healthcare in underserved rural areas of Sindh.
data.heading: Digital Health Camp & Dispensary System
data.description:
A mobile and web system that helps an NGO deliver and record healthcare in underserved rural areas of Sindh.

Our Solution & Results

We combined a mobile app for doctors, dispensers and social workers with a web dashboard for administrators. It records consultations, diagnoses and prescriptions, tracks referrals, monitors mother and child health with vaccination schedules, and sends stock alerts. Offline mode syncs automatically once a connection is available.

Records are now more accurate and accountability has improved. Patients in remote regions receive more consistent care.
data.challenge_description: Medical teams in remote villages worked with paper records, weak internet and limited stock visibility, making continuity of care difficult.

data.title: Offline Maternal Care App for Field Health Workers

data.heading: Offline Maternal Care App for Field Health Workers

An Android app that helps health workers monitor pregnancies and manage referrals in remote parts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

We built an offline-first Android app with secure electronic medical records, role-based screens, risk assessment tools, referral workflows and educational audio content.

Data collection is now structured, risk monitoring has improved, and referrals move faster, strengthening care in low-resource settings.
data.hero_image_alt: Offline Maternal Care App for Field Health Workers

data.title: Smart Home Control App
data.short_description: An IoT mobile app that lets homeowners control lighting, climate and security from their phone.
data.heading: Smart Home Control App
data.description:
An IoT mobile app that lets homeowners control lighting, climate and security from their phone.

Our Solution & Results

We integrated ESP8266 and ESP32 microcontrollers for real-time control and scalable connectivity, with secure architecture and energy optimisation. A user-centred design keeps navigation clear and pairing straightforward.

Users can now manage their homes remotely with custom automation settings, in an app that is easy to use and supports energy-efficient living.
data.challenge_description: Home automation is often complex to set up and use. The client wanted control to feel simple for every member of the household.

data.title: Health Engagement App for a WASH Study
data.short_description: An Android app that delivered health messages and collected daily data from participants in a UNDP-funded hygiene study.
data.card_image_alt: Health Engagement App for a WASH Study
data.heading: Health Engagement App for a WASH Study
data.description:
An Android app that delivered health messages and collected daily data from participants in a UNDP-funded hygiene study.

Our Solution & Results

We built push notifications for text, image, video and audio, with user segmentation and a multilingual interface. The app also includes consent-based GPS tracking, daily health reports and built-in surveys.

The app became a core part of the study, supporting health communication, behaviour tracking, COVID-19 symptom reporting and data-driven evaluation.
data.hero_image_alt: Health Engagement App for a WASH Study
data.challenge_description: The study needed to reach participants with targeted messages and gather reliable daily data, even where connectivity was poor.

gallery.image_alt: Health Engagement App for a WASH Study

data.title: Preschool Management & Parent Communication App
data.short_description: A full-stack app that connects preschool teachers, administrators and parents in one secure place.
data.heading: Preschool Management & Parent Communication App
data.description:
A full-stack app that connects preschool teachers, administrators and parents in one secure place.

Our Solution & Results

We built the app in React Native with REST APIs (Node.js/Django) and Firebase for authentication, storage, database and notifications. Modules cover attendance, media documentation, scheduling, parent messaging and offline caching.

The preschool now has real-time communication, central child records and digital attendance, with stronger privacy and smoother coordination.
data.challenge_description: Staff spent too much time on attendance, updates and scheduling, and parents wanted a clearer view of their child's day.

data.title: Maternal Health Companion for Rural Communities
data.short_description: A lightweight, culturally appropriate app that guides expectant mothers and connects them with local health workers.
data.heading: Maternal Health Companion for Rural Communities
data.description:
A lightweight, culturally appropriate app that guides expectant mothers and connects them with local health workers.

Our Solution & Results

We built pregnancy tracking, appointment reminders, health alerts and education on nutrition and child health. Dashboards help programme managers monitor engagement and outcomes, and the lightweight design runs well on basic phones.

Mothers now have better access to maternal health information, which has encouraged earlier care-seeking and more informed decisions.
data.challenge_description: Women in Pakistan's merged areas faced barriers to reliable pregnancy information and care. Many had low literacy and limited internet access.

data.title: Computer Labs for Under-Resourced Schools
data.short_description: Fully equipped computer labs that bring digital learning to students in schools with limited resources.
data.heading: Computer Labs for Under-Resourced Schools
data.description:
Fully equipped computer labs that bring digital learning to students in schools with limited resources.

Our Solution & Results

We handled structured cabling, LAN deployment, installation of computers and network devices, secure configuration and power backup planning. Every system was tested and tuned for long-term use.

Thousands of students now have access to computer-based learning, and the schools are better equipped for modern teaching.
data.challenge_description: Many partner schools had no working computer facilities, so students missed out on basic digital skills.

data.title: AWS Migration for CRM & Billing Systems
data.short_description: An end-to-end move of legacy on-premise CRM and billing systems to a managed AWS cloud environment.
data.card_image_alt: AWS Migration for CRM & Billing Systems
data.heading: AWS Migration for CRM & Billing Systems
data.description:
An end-to-end move of legacy on-premise CRM and billing systems to a managed AWS cloud environment.

Our Solution & Results

We started with a pre-migration assessment and long-term cost forecast. We then moved customer and billing data to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3 with near-zero downtime, and delivered a migration strategy report, security compliance documents and a post-migration cost-performance analysis.

The systems are now faster, more reliable and easier to scale, with clear visibility of cloud spending.
data.hero_image_alt: AWS Migration for CRM & Billing Systems
data.challenge_description: Ageing on-premise systems limited performance and growth. The business needed to move critical customer and billing data safely, without disrupting operations.

gallery.image_alt: AWS Migration for CRM & Billing Systems
